scope: Two unchanged round pipelines, one unchanged SiLU pipeline, external handshake metadata, atomic MAC-result buffering, and serialized INT8 writeback.

requirements: A MAC task reserves one of two atomic result slots on its accepted first beat; Q + R <= 2 and R <= 1 at every edge.
A terminal MAC handshake supplies signed alpha/beta/gamma, atomic fault, layer, position, and base/output channel identity.
i_channel_base is aligned to three lanes. DW uses a one-hot i_lane_mask and emits base+selected-lane; the 24-channel PW uses bases 0..21 in steps of three and mask 3'b111.
Output is ready/valid signed INT8 with the unchanged 16-bit tag layout {layer[0], position[3:0], channel[4:0], reserved[5:0]}.
Exact wrapper port names and hierarchical verification taps must be frozen before the testbench is compiled.
Asynchronous low reset cancels both group entries, the reservation, all round valid/tag/fault stages, all SiLU valid stages, all eight metadata valid entries, and pending output valid.
Reset does not claim to clear RAM contents; the table-loaded state follows the unchanged SiLU contract and requires complete reload before inference.
A terminal MAC fault emits no scalar, latches tile fault, prevents tile publication, and recovery requires reset plus table reload.
Test reset independently while each pipeline stage, each FIFO slot, the reservation, and output hold contain valid state.
Both road_round_shift instances remain nine enabled register stages with II=1; silu_shared_unit remains six enabled stages with II=1 and no tag port.
With no stalls, scalar accepted by pre-round at edge t is visible final-valid after edge t+23 and writes on handshake edge t+24.
Pipeline busy intervals overlap and must not be summed as core latency.
A held final output must keep INT8 data and tag stable; downstream backpressure may fill empty upstream stages but may not create an extra handshake after capacity is exhausted.
The two-entry FIFO pushes only on actual terminal MAC result handshake and pops a group only after its last selected scalar is accepted by pre-round.
Metadata pushes only on actual SiLU input handshake and pops only on actual SiLU output handshake; clock-based tag shifting is forbidden.
Pre-round advance depends on whether its tail can enter SiLU; post-round advance depends on whether final output can transfer.
Simultaneous push/pop must preserve count and order. Queue-full handling must be proven with the reservation included, not only completed results.
A held table reload request blocks only new admission. It must not block draining already accepted queue/pre/SiLU/meta/post work; table ready asserts only after global drain.
The testbench scoreboard is keyed by tag and phase because independent stages can produce debug events on the same edge.
MAC inputs are signed INT32 and are sign-extended before multiplying by fixed pre factors 1, 3, and 5 in a signed 64-bit product.
Lane shifts are 0, 2, and 4; post factor is 1 and post shift is 4; both round stages use nearest-even and signed INT16 saturation.
Final INT8 saturation is combinational over the held post-round INT16 value.
Channel addition is checked before five-bit packing; the actual PW runner rejects base above 21 and DW rejects selected channels above 15.
The six reserved tag bits are opaque identity bits. Any temporary phase encoding must be explicitly stripped or contractually exposed at the final output.
Instantiate two unchanged road_round_shift blocks and one unchanged silu_shared_unit; do not clone SiLU RAM or change MAC arithmetic.
Infer only two complete triple entries and eight 16-bit metadata entries; fixed coefficient optimization is tool evidence, not an RTL assumption.
No gated clocks, new timing exceptions, training, board programming, Flash changes, or production-core edits are in scope.
Physical evidence must use a new top containing the real runner, dynamic stores, MAC, both rounds, SiLU RAM, queues, writeback, readback, and narrow shell.

required_cases: continuous scalar flow and PW three-lane ordering
long output backpressure with stable data/tag
both group slots full plus denied third reservation
all four FIFO push/pop combinations, including a second group push while alpha or beta of the head is consumed
1023-entry partial table denies input, and a held address-zero reload waits through global drain without deadlock
reset with valid state in every pipeline stage and FIFO position
terminal fault in alpha, beta, and gamma with atomic suppression
DW selected-lane changes and PW lane-specific coefficients
all four frozen v8 layer cases with acc/pre/silu/post/output checked by layer-position-channel-phase
original v9 MAC 123 vectors and original v8 four-layer regression rerun from copied inputs in the new stage
invalid_pass_conditions: readmem warning or missing vector file
X/Z value accepted as a comparison pass
assuming old single debug-port event order
claiming a tool or physical result that was not run

risks.risk: Result capacity can be overbooked while a MAC task is still in flight.
risks.control: Reserve on accepted first beat and assert Q + R <= 2, R <= 1 every edge.

risks.risk: SiLU has no tag port and stalls globally at its output.
risks.control: Use the external eight-entry FIFO driven only by actual SiLU input/output handshakes.

risks.risk: A fault after earlier internal writes can expose a partial tile.
risks.control: Latch tile fault and prohibit done/export; reset and complete table reload are the only recovery.

risks.risk: Fixed latency is incorrectly asserted while stalled.
risks.control: Assert +23/+24 only in the no-stall case; otherwise verify conservation, order, stability, and eventual progress after ready returns.

risks.risk: Old serial debug assumptions miss simultaneous stage handshakes.
risks.control: Expose independent stage handshakes to a tag-indexed scoreboard.
